entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
Sam Jones. Order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Sam. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 18 days ago. I'm sorry to hear you're looking to return it. To understand the problem better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not working. That's the issue. I wouldn't be calling if I just didn't like the color.
I understand. Could you tell me a bit more about how it's not working?
It won't sync with my phone anymore. It worked for a week, and now nothing. The thing is basically broken. I just want my money back for this defective product.
I see. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Please hold one moment while I review our return policy for your item.

Okay, Sam, thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and since you received the item 18 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. So, I can definitely process that return for you.
Oh. Fine. What do I need to do?

I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the defective unit, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You will. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sam?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
